findings.description: One entry per distinct defect found in the diff. Empty array if the diff is clean.

severity.description: high = a correctness or security defect that can cause data loss, financial loss, a crash, or a security hole in production (e.g. missing authorization check, unchecked balance leading to overdraft, SQL injection, nil/null dereference on a reachable path). medium = a real bug with limited blast radius or an unhandled edge case. low = style, naming, or a nit with no runtime impact.

line.description: Best-effort line number in the new file; 0 if unknown.

issue.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

recommendation.description: The concrete fix, in one sentence.
